entities.name: Reha Oğuz Türkkan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Reha Oğuz Türkkan was a Turkish academic, journalist and a leading ideologue of Turkish nationalism. During his lifetime, he published many books which focused on Turkish nationalism and Pan-Turkism. He was the grandnephew of Fakhri Pasha.

entities.summary: Reha Oğuz Türkkan was a Turkish academic, journalist and a leading ideologue of Turkish nationalism. During his lifetime, he published many books which focused on Turkish nationalism and Pan-Turkism. He was the grandnephew of Fakhri Pasha.
